title: Move sessions out of process memory
summary: Sessions live in a `Map` inside each API process, so every deploy logs everyone out and the second replica can't see the first one's logins. Before I write the plan, I want to settle how the shared store should behave: **three questions to start**.
status: Round 1 of questions. No code changed yet.

blocks.title: Scope
blocks.question: Ship the shared store on its own, with the list of signed-in devices as a follow-up?
blocks.context: The store alone fixes the logouts. The device list adds a settings page and two endpoints.

options.label: Store now, device list later
options.summary: Smallest change that fixes the bug.

options.label: Both in this change
options.summary: One migration instead of two, but twice the review.

blocks.title: Session store
blocks.question: Keep sessions in a Postgres table?
blocks.context: We already run Postgres 15 (`src/db.ts`). Peak load is about 40 auth checks per second.

options.label: Postgres table
options.summary: No new infrastructure; one indexed read per request.
options.evidence: Spiked on a scratch branch: the read adds 1.1 ms at p95.

options.label: Redis
options.summary: Fastest, but a new service to deploy, monitor and back up.
